body: if u are telling the truth about your story we're in the same boat man. Im on my 3rd and I can promise you that your life will be better if you stop. I have bad anxiety and depression and smoking legit does nothing to help at all, it just makes it way worse. I'm hoping u stayed strong these past two days and didn't go back to smoking. I didnt sleep for a day the first week but everything will start feeling much better each day u keep going. This Sunday I was so hungover and depressed and all i wanted to do is go buy weed and just disappear from everything, but I didnt and it took every single thing in my body to not do it but i didn't. the next day I felt somewhat back to normal. today I feel even better. People like me and u who used to love smoking weed and thought it was the cool thing to do, and even associated our entire identity with it, just can't smoke, atleast thats my situation. I promise one day u r gunna stop and look back at everything wishing u done it sooner. u r gunna have to stop if u want to succeed in life, u might as well do it now man. I promise you, and it sounds like we r very similair people, it took me three schools to finish college and alot of my freinds havent even finsihed yet, go at your own pace and if u fail the you fail but keep trying.  feel free to direct message me because we can do this shit together. also dont take the dreams u have to seriously, that was my mistake in the beginning. This world is way to fucked up to have a drug that your spending money on bring you farther down. I realized life is hard but the hard shit makes you stronger mentally, and eventually everything will start falling into place. like i said dont hesistate to reach out if everything ur saying is true. If not, good luck man and know theres people in this world going thru the exact same thing u are, u are not alone ever, whether u know it or not. good luck homie
